packages.name: @tuix/core
packages.summary: Shared types, errors, services, modules, and events for Tuix apps.
packages.purpose: The package defines foundation types, error classes, and service tags. It owns Live I/O implementations for the terminal, input, renderer, and storage. It also provides the module base, registry, and event bus that other packages use.
packages.whenToUse: Import this package when you need shared types or error helpers. Use it when you define modules or publish events. Prefer @tuix/platform for app-facing Live service layers.
mainConcepts: Service tags for terminal, input, renderer, and storage
Live service layers under services/live
ModuleBase and ModuleRegistry lifecycle
Typed EventBus channels
Shared error classes and recovery helpers
keyExports: TerminalService — Effect tag for terminal I/O
InputService — Effect tag for input streams
RendererService — Effect tag for render output
StorageService — Effect tag for key-value storage
LiveServices — merged Live layers for bootstrap
ModuleBase — base class for module lifecycle
ModuleRegistry — register and look up modules
EventBus — publish and subscribe to typed events
TerminalError / InputError / RenderError — typed errors
Effect / Context / Layer — re-exported from effect

packages.name: @tuix/platform
packages.summary: Public facade for Live services, capabilities, and graphics.
packages.purpose: The package re-exports Live service layers and service tags from @tuix/core. It exposes capability detection and graphics encode helpers for apps. It does not implement Live I/O itself.
packages.whenToUse: Import this package at app bootstrap to provide LiveServices. Use it when you detect terminal capabilities or write graphics. Prefer this package over deep @tuix/core Live paths in apps.
mainConcepts: LiveServices as the default service layer bundle
Service tags for dependency injection and tests
Capability detection from environment and probes
Graphics encode and decode for sixel, kitty, and iTerm2
writeGraphicsLive helper for image output
keyExports: LiveServices — merged terminal, input, renderer, storage layers
TerminalService / InputService / RendererService / StorageService — tags
detectCapabilities — probe terminal features from env
selectGraphicsProtocol — choose sixel, kitty, iTerm2, or none
encodeGraphics / decodeGraphics — image protocol helpers
parsePrimaryDA / probeFromEnv / mergeProbeResults — DA probe helpers
writeGraphicsLive — encode and write an image via Live terminal
PLATFORM_VERSION — package version string

packages.name: @tuix/ansi
packages.summary: ANSI colors, styles, borders, and text render helpers.
packages.purpose: The package builds ANSI escape sequences for terminal text. It styles strings with colors, decorations, padding, and borders. It also measures visual width and strips ANSI codes.
packages.whenToUse: Use this package when you style terminal text by hand. Use it for box borders, gradients, and color profiles. Higher layers may call it for you when you use views or widgets.
mainConcepts: Style builder for colors, bold, padding, and borders
renderStyled output for styled multi-line text
Border presets and renderBox frames
Color parse and ColorProfile for terminal depth
visualWidth, stripAnsi, and pad for layout
keyExports: style / Style — fluent style builder
renderStyled — apply style props to text
colorize — wrap text in a named ANSI code
stripAnsi / visualWidth / truncate / pad — text width tools
renderBox / border — box drawing helpers
parseColor / ColorProfile — color input and depth
fgRgb / bgRgb / fg256 / bg256 — low-level color sequences
ANSI_CODES — named escape code map

packages.name: @tuix/input
packages.summary: Keyboard, mouse, and focus services for terminal input.
packages.purpose: The package parses key events and matches shortcuts. It routes mouse hits to components by bounds. It manages focus order, traps, and keyboard navigation.
packages.whenToUse: Use this package when you handle keys, mouse clicks, or focus. Import KeyUtils for quit and navigation bindings. Wire FocusService and HitTestService when you build interactive views.
mainConcepts: KeyEvent model and KeyType enum
KeyUtils matching and common bindings
FocusService for tab order and focus traps
HitTestService for component bounds
MouseRouterService for click and hover routing
keyExports: KeyUtils — match keys and build bindings
KeyType / KeyEvent — key event model
parseChar — build a KeyEvent from a character
FocusService / FocusServiceLive — focus registration and move
HitTestService / createBounds — mouse hit testing
MouseRouterService — route mouse events to handlers
clickHandler / pressReleaseHandler — mouse handler helpers
ComponentNotFoundError / KeyEventParseError — typed errors

packages.name: @tuix/storage
packages.summary: Key-value storage with TTL, memory and filesystem backends.
packages.purpose: The package stores values by key with optional time-to-live. It provides in-memory and filesystem backends as Effect layers. It also exposes useStorage and Storage for JSX context.
packages.whenToUse: Use this package when you persist app data or cache sessions. Choose MemoryStorageLayer for tests and short-lived state. Choose FilesystemStorageLayer when data must survive restarts.
mainConcepts: Storage interface with get, set, delete, and keys
Optional TTL on set and cleanup of expired entries
MemoryStorage for process-local data
FilesystemStorage for on-disk persistence
Effect layers and JSX useStorage context
keyExports: Storage / StorageService — interface and Effect tag
makeMemoryStorage / MemoryStorage — in-memory backend
makeFilesystemStorage / FilesystemStorage — disk backend
MemoryStorageLayer / FilesystemStorageLayer — Effect layers
useStorage / Storage / provideStorage — JSX context helpers
StorageEntry / StorageOptions — entry shape and TTL options
StorageError — typed storage failure
